content:
sara-support: Heads up — Fintegra (acct: FIN-983) hit a payment hold that’s blocking their Net 60 approval. Invoice 2026-FTG-452 is stuck because they didn’t include a PO and VAT amount doesn’t match what we have on file. They’re escalating.

finance-ella: Can you paste the invoice metadata and the VAT/tax ID the customer submitted? Need to confirm if it’s a mismatch vs our billing system.

sara-support: Copy of the invoice metadata from customer email:```
invoice_id: 2026-FTG-452
amount: 63,400.00 EUR
vat_id: DE123456789
po_number: (blank)
payment_method: saved_card_ending_4242
terms_requested: Net 60
```

billing-bot: automated: payment_attempt_failed invoice=2026-FTG-452 reason="card_declined" code=card_decline

sam-sales: They verbally agreed Net 60 during the trial transition, but finance needs a PO for our Net Terms SOW. Customer says legal signoff delayed; asking if we can allow arrears retroactively.

finance-ella: We require either a valid PO on file or an upfront deposit for Net >45 as per policy. If card declined, we can attempt retry or request a wire. Did the card decline give a reason?

sara-support: Customer pasted the Stripe decline message: "Your card was declined - please use a different card or contact your bank." They also claim the VAT ID is correct — says their treasury uses a different registration for EU sales.

legal-maya: If they want Net 60 without PO, we need a signed amendment to the MSA plus credit check. If they can provide a valid government VAT cert and supplier PO within 7 days, we can provisionally release services.

customer-success-liz: Customer is asking for a short-term workaround — their prod flow is blocked because we block API access when invoices are unpaid. Is there a safe temporary diversion?

eng-ops-john: Quick note: API auth blocks are enforced by account state; we can enable read-only access to logs/endpoints while payment dispute is open, but not generation endpoints. That requires a 15-min config change and an ops ticket.

finance-ella: Options for Fintegra: 1) provide PO + VAT proof within 7 days and we release Net 60, 2) pay partial upfront (50%) to lift hold and start services, 3) complete a wire transfer and we mark invoice paid on receipt. Which does sales prefer?

sam-sales: I'll ask them to submit PO + VAT cert asap. If they push back, offer 50% upfront charge to unblock. I flagged this as a high-urgency renewal risk.

sara-support: FYI the customer also reported intermittent 403s earlier today after a key rotation — might be unrelated but they linked it to services being blocked. Repro steps they sent:```
# repro
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xxxx" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# response
{"error":"account_suspended","message":"Please contact billing"}
```

eng-ops-john: That matches account_suspended state. Once finance signals release we can flip the account state. Leaving note: don’t re-enable write endpoints until payment confirmation.

legal-maya: I'll prep a short amendment template that permits provisional access on receipt of PO + VAT attestation. Can finance confirm the 7-day carveout?

finance-ella: Confirmed. If PO + VAT proof arrives within 7 days, we'll allow Net 60 and clear the hold pending credit check. Otherwise proceed with partial payment or wire.

customer-success-liz: I'll communicate the three options and timeline to Fintegra and get back here. Can someone from finance add the account hold reason to the billing portal so the customer sees the next steps?

sara-support: Thanks — creating a follow-up with the customer now. Will paste the PO link and ask for VAT cert scan.

sam-sales: Heads up — if they accept 50% upfront, I'll get finance to confirm receipt so eng can enable the endpoints same day. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: automated: ticket_created ticket=BH-9217 assignee=finance-ella subject="Invoice hold: 2026-FTG-452 - missing PO / card declined"

finance-ella: Added note in portal and assigned credit analyst. Updating ticket.

sara-support: Closing loop for now — will update thread with customer reply or PO.
